scripts.build: npx esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/_worker.js --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --minify && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -rf public/* dist/public/ && mkdir -p dist/static && cp -rf public/static/* dist/static/ && find public -maxdepth 1 -name '*.html' ! -name 'index.html' -exec cp {} dist/ \; && cp -f public/_headers dist/_headers 2>/dev/null || true && cp -f public/service-worker.js dist/service-worker.js 2>/dev/null || true && cp -f public/manifest.json dist/manifest.json 2>/dev/null || true && bash scripts/update-routes.sh
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name webapp
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute jiyushindo-gakushu-production --local --file=./seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute jiyushindo-gakushu-production --local --file=./demo_progress_data.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed
